desc: Implement and verify the rolling remainder DP transition for substrings ending at each position, including leading zeros and one-digit substrings.
Explain why each modulus-\(d\) state is queried only when the current last digit equals \(d\), and ensure zero-ending substrings are excluded.
Produce the Python `Solution.countSubstrings` implementation with \(O(9n)\) time and constant auxiliary space.
Test the implementation against all three examples and edge cases such as `"0"`, `"111"`, strings containing many zeros, and a single non-zero digit.
